title: Feedback echo
description: A precise luminous orbit leaves a retained echo that slowly stretches and fades.
useCase: Art-direct trails from actual previous frames with a controlled decay rate.
reducedMotion: A representative retained-history composition stays still. Persistence changes render one frame.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. One retained RGBA8 framebuffer texture with frame-rate-adjusted decay; feedback history resets on resize and remount.
look: Near-black teal field with one glowing teal elliptical ring crossed by a fine diagonal line, faint ghosted afterimages trailing inside it.
motion: A thin ring and bar drift, rotate and shift gold to teal; each frame redraws the last slightly contracted, shifted left and dimmed, leaving trailing echoes; a slider sets persistence.
adapt: The `FRAGMENT` shader draws the orbit and blends the previous frame from `u_state`, which `draw` refreshes via `copyTexSubImage2D`. Swap the `ring` and `bar` shapes, tune decay and zoom there and `controlRef` (0.73); keep context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
